summary: TOOL-4 Filter products by category and brand
description:
As a customer, I want to filter so I can narrow down the catalogue.

* Selecting one category → only products from that category appear.
* Selecting two categories → products from both appear.
* Combining a category and a brand → only products matching both appear.
* Unchecking all filters → the full list returns.

criteria.text: Selecting one category → only products from that category appear.
Selecting two categories → products from both appear.
Combining a category and a brand → only products matching both appear.
Unchecking all filters → the full list returns.

cases.title: Filter by a single category
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue is open with no filters applied. <a category that contains at least two products, and at least one product outside that category> exists in the catalogue.
steps: Open the product catalogue with no filters applied.
Select the category <a category that contains at least two products>.
cases.expected: Only products from the selected category appear in the list; products from other categories are no longer shown.

cases.title: Filter by two categories
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue is open with no filters applied. <two categories that each contain at least one product> exist in the catalogue.
steps: Open the product catalogue with no filters applied.
Select the second category <category B> in addition to the first.
cases.expected: Products from both selected categories appear in the list.

cases.title: Combine a category filter with a brand filter
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue is open with no filters applied. <a category and a brand that have at least one product in common, plus products in that category from other brands and products of that brand in other categories> exist in the catalogue.
steps: Open the product catalogue with no filters applied.
Select the brand <brand X> while the category remains selected.
cases.expected: Only products that belong to category <category A> and are of brand <brand X> appear; products matching only one of the two filters are not shown.

cases.title: Category and brand combination with no matching products
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue is open with no filters applied. <a category and a brand that have no products in common> exist in the catalogue.
steps: Open the product catalogue with no filters applied.
Select the brand <brand Y>, which has no products in category <category A>.
cases.expected: No products appear, because only products matching both filters are shown. The exact wording/appearance of the empty result (not specified in the story).

cases.title: Unchecking all filters restores the full list
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue is open with no filters applied. <a category and a brand that each have at least one product> exist in the catalogue.
steps: Open the product catalogue with no filters applied and note the full list of products.
Uncheck the category <category A> so that no filters remain selected.
cases.expected: The full product list returns, matching the unfiltered list noted in step 1.
